question:
If DDL stated directly in the post_hook it executes after the materialization as expected, but if it is moved to a macro it executes before the materialization.

This can be illustrated by this example:

{{ 
    config(
        materialized = 'view'
        ,pre_hook = testCreate()
        ,post_hook = testDrop() 
    )
}}

select * from testdb.sdl.xxx

The macros are defined as:

{%- macro testCreate() -%}

    {% if execute %}
        {{ log("creating table...", info=true) }}
        {%- do run_query("create or replace table testdb.sdl.xxx as (select 1 x)") -%}
    {% endif %}

{%- endmacro -%}

{%- macro testDrop() -%}
    
    {% if execute %}
        {{ log("dropping table...", info=true) }}
        {%- do run_query("drop table if exists testdb.sdl.xxx") -%}
    {% endif %}
    
{%- endmacro -%}

Building this results in an error:

08:35:42  1 of 1 START sql view model SDL.test ........................................... [RUN]
08:35:42  creating table...
08:35:44  dropping table...
08:35:44  1 of 1 ERROR creating sql view model SDL.test .................................. [ERROR in 2.01s]
08:35:45  
08:35:45  Finished running 1 view model in 0 hours 0 minutes and 3.99 seconds (3.99s).
08:35:45  
08:35:45  Completed with 1 error, 0 partial successes, and 0 warnings:
08:35:45  
08:35:45    Database Error in model test (models/test.sql)
  002003 (42S02): SQL compilation error:
  Object 'TESTDB.SDL.XXX' does not exist or not authorized.
  compiled code at /tmp/dbt/target/run/test/models/test.sql

If the DDL is stated directly in the config block, it works as expected:

{{ 
    config(
        materialized = 'view'
        ,pre_hook = "create or replace table testdb.sdl.xxx as (select 1 x)"
        ,post_hook = "drop table if exists testdb.sdl.xxx"
    )
}}

01:48:25.055508 [info ] [Thread-2 (]: 1 of 1 START sql view model SDL.test ........................................... [RUN]
01:48:27.129852 [info ] [Thread-2 (]: 1 of 1 OK created sql view model SDL.test ...................................... [SUCCESS 1 in 2.07s]

Why?
title: dbt post_hook executes before materialization if done in macro
answer:
This issue happens because of the presence of run_query in the macro. Hooks are evaluated at compilation stage and executed at run time. When the pre/post hooks are strings, DBT defers execution until execution time but when the pre/post hooks contains executable statemnet then it gets executed immediately and not being stored/deferred like it was done for strings.

To address this you can just include the statement in the macros and it will execute in its due time.

I tested this and it worked as expected


{%- macro testCreate() -%}
    create or replace table test.first_table as (select 1 x)
{%- endmacro -%}

{%- macro testDrop() -%}
    drop table if exists test.first_table
{%- endmacro -%}
